data.title: Khlong Luang police chief transferred over alleged bribery
data.description: The chief of the Khlong Luang police station in Pathum Thani has been transferred to an inactive post pending an investigation after a recording purported to be of him soliciting bribes from the operator of a bar was circulated online.

data.title: Italian embassy apologises for rowdy teens on BTS
data.description: The Embassy of Italy on Saturday apologised to the Thai people over “the inappropriate behaviour of a group of Italian underage tourists” on a BTS Skytrain in Bangkok that generated heated conversations online, while strongly condemning their actions.

data.title: PM: Nation must set terms for detente with Cambodia
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has reaffirmed that Thailand is prepared to restore relations with Cambodia, but only under conditions that safeguard the country's national interests and sovereignty.

data.title: Dugong carcass found with tusks removed in Krabi
data.description: KRABI - Authorities are investigating the death of a dugong found stranded on a beach in this southern province after discovering that both of its tusks had been removed.

data.title: iLaw director undeterred by Bhumjaithai threats
data.description: ILaw director Yingcheep Atchanont has vowed to continue releasing evidence alleging manipulation of the 2024 Senate election, despite the ruling Bhumjaithai Party's threat to pursue legal action against him.

data.title: Elephant death investigation report disputed
data.description: Forestry officials are questioning the environment ministry's investigation into the death of the wild elephant Seedor Hu Pab, claiming that its conclusions contradict scientific findings previously reached by wildlife specialists.

data.title: Fake coffee seized in B2.6m raid
data.description: Police have seized 226,720 counterfeit Nescafe, Ovaltine and Downy products worth 2.63 million baht after raiding two sites and arresting four suspects.

data.title: Linked databases eye traffic fine dodgers
data.description: The Ministry of Transport, the Department of Land Transport (DLT) and the Royal Thai Police will link their databases to strengthen enforcement against motorists who fail to pay traffic fines, with the measure applying only to tickets issued from Aug 1.

data.title: New pension formula promises fairer retirement benefits
data.description: The cabinet approved in principle the Career Average Revalued Earnings (Care) formula, a major reform of the Social Security pension system aimed at addressing long-standing complaints over unfair retirement benefits.

data.title: Government shifts gears
data.description: The Anutin Charnvirakul administration appears to be entering a new phase of governance — one marked less by headline-grabbing populist initiatives than by difficult policy recalibrations. Over the past few weeks, the government has quietly delayed, suspended or softened a number of high-profile initiatives, the latest being the Commerce Ministry’s proposed 40-baht curry rice scheme.

data.title: PP raises concerns over budget
data.description: People's Party (PP) deputy leader and list-MP Sirikanya Tansakun has raised concerns over unusually high and overlapping budget requests in the proposed 2027 fiscal budget, particularly for cloud services.

data.title: Elephant death investigation report disputed
data.description: Forestry officials are questioning the environment ministry's investigation into the death of the wild elephant Seedor Hu Pab, claiming that its conclusions contradict scientific findings previously reached by wildlife specialists.

data.title: PP MP postpones grilling in forex case
data.description: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) yesterday granted a request by People's Party list-MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu to postpone his first appearance for questioning in connection with an alleged foreign exchange investment scam.

data.title: Phuket illegal hotel blitz ramps up
data.description: The government has intensified its crackdown on illegal hotels in Phuket after inspections found three properties operating without licences.

data.title: China reaffirms its neutrality
data.description: China has assured Thailand it remains neutral in the Thai-Cambodian border dispute, saying military equipment supplied to Cambodia was delivered under an earlier agreement, Defence Minister Lt Gen Adul Boonthumjaroen said.

data.title: Axe set to fall on Land Bridge
data.description: The government is set to end the Land Bridge megaproject after a review found low financial viability, increased budget risks and environmental concerns.

data.title: 17 held after online store scam ring busted
data.description: Thai police have dismantled a fraudulent investment network that lured victims into opening fake online stores under the name “Style Cycle”, arresting 17 suspects and seizing assets worth more than 23 million baht.

data.title: Hospital probes infant death after NICU lunch party
data.description: ANG THONG - Ang Thong Hospital has expressed condolences to the family of a five-day-old infant who died in its neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) and acknowledged that hospital staff had held a lunch gathering in an area adjacent to the ward, separated from patients only by a plastic curtain.

data.title: Thai woman berates noisy tourists on BTS
data.description: A heated confrontation between a Thai woman and a group of foreign teenage tourists aboard a Bangkok BTS Skytrain on Friday has gone viral, triggering widespread debate on social media over public behaviour and cultural respect.
